description: This file serves as the entry point for a React web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component. It then creates a React root element and renders the App component within React's StrictMode, attaching it to an HTML element with the ID 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render the React application into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root element.
